newsitem.title: PERU: PERU CENTRAL BANK OFFERS 100 MLN SOLES 28-DAY CDS.
newsitem.headline: PERU CENTRAL BANK OFFERS 100 MLN SOLES 28-DAY CDS.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru announced Thursday an auction of Certificates of Deposit (CDs), saying it would accept bids for 28-day CDs worth 100 million soles until 1430 local time/1530 EDT BCQZ.
All the certificates have an August 8 starting date.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates, which will be announced after the auction, is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
